title: Nanodrop dsDNA Quantification Protocol
author: Owen Butler
materials: Login to the computer, launch NanoEight Software.

steps.title: Configure Software
steps.instruction: Open the NanoDrop Eight software and select 'dsDNA' for double stranded DNA.

steps.title: Clean Pedestals
steps.instruction: Gently wipe the pedestals with DI water using a KimWipe, ensuring no water is left behind.

steps.title: Perform Blanking
steps.instruction: Blank the pedestals using the appropriate buffer to calibrate the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the desired pedestals for blanking (up to eight).
Add 1 µL of NFW or 1 µL Elution Buffer (depending on the sample solvent) to the center of the selected pedestals, avoiding bubbles or off-centered liquids.
Close the arm and hit run to initiate blanking.

steps.title: Measure Samples
steps.instruction: Quantify the dsDNA samples on the pedestals.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the cleaning process by gently wiping the pedestals with DI water on a KimWipe.
Add 1 µL of sample to the center of the pedestal, ensuring no bubbles or off-centered liquids.
Record the order of samples in the ELN.
Click the play button at the top right to measure up to 8 samples.

steps.title: Export Data
steps.instruction: End the experiment and save the results.

substeps.instruction: Use the button in the top-right corner to end the experiment.
Select the desired file format(s) (e.g., .csv) and export the data to Excel.
Upload the exported files to the preferred storage location and rename samples to reflect their identities.

steps.title: Process Additional Samples
steps.instruction: If more than 8 samples are required, repeat the measurement process without re-blanking.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the pedestals down with DI water on a KimWipe.
Select the next column, load, and read the next samples.
Repeat for all remaining samples, cleaning pedestals between each set of 8.
Do not perform another blank measurement between columns; all samples use the initial blank.

steps.title: Final Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the instrument and shut down the software.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the cleaning process once more.
